name: 37408 · Chattanooga, TN
findings: ZIP 37408 (Chattanooga) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37408 (Chattanooga) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 37408 (Chattanooga) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 7.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
